decision.interpretation: Bold document-type word positioned centrally on page 1, serving as the primary title identifier for the legal instrument.
Subtitle line immediately following the main title, specifying the decree's substantive scope and amending purpose.
Title continuation line clarifying the regulatory jurisdiction, laid out sequentially with preceding title words.
Standard chapter heading, bold and distinct, introducing the first major substantive section of the decree.
Section subheading, bold and centered, opening the specific topic area within Chapter I.
Article heading, bold and numbered, explicitly naming the provision and introducing the subsequent annulment list.
